jobs.title: Manager Product Research & GTM, Program Adoption
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Work Timings - Monday to Friday;  
Timings- 1 Noon to 10 PM (Day Shift)  
We're looking for exceptional talent to join Amazon's Product Acceleration Team (PAT), a specialized unit that sits at the intersection of product development, seller experience, and Seller research. PAT plays a crucial role in fast-tracking product improvements through direct seller engagement, rapid research execution, and actionable insights generation.  
  
We’re looking for an enthusiastic user experience researcher to explore the world of building amazon products and generate insights that connect product experiences to business needs. Your focus will cover all aspects of customer research, from learning more about our customers types to uncovering problems that need to be solved to usability testing new designs. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand the decisions that need to be made and then conduct research projects to gather the correct data to help make those decisions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  

* Plan and execute quantitative and qualitative research studies to shape Product roadmap. That may include large-scale surveys, usability testing, or conducting interviews. Select the right methodology, while demonstrating good judgement in making trade-offs between speed and rigor.

  

* Understand business needs and develop a product marketing strategy and roadmap in partnership with business and product stakeholders.

  

* Deliver findings that will directly address the business need, create actionable recommendations, and work with stakeholders to shape product roadmaps based on data.

  

* Generate insights from business analytics, as well as customer feedback. Synthesize and triangulate data from various sources to deliver insights to the business. Know when enough data has been collected to answer the question.

  

* Generate ideas on new or more efficient ways to drive product marketing at scale

  

* Partner closely with product and business teams on the full product lifecycle (customer research, ideation, proposal, launch and post-launch analysis). Develop relationships and processes to connect decision-makers to customer needs.

  

* Lead an extended team of Research Managers and Marketing managers to meet overall goals

  

* Develop weekly metrics to track critical inputs and outputs and report out in weekly business reviews

  
About the team  
Seller Enablement Growth (SEG) specializes in driving seller adoption of new features and programs across Amazon's marketplace, working closely with product teams to gather Voice of Seller feedback, accelerate feature launches, and ensure seller success through strategic engagement and educational initiatives.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience managing teams
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional email and push marketing campaigns (including automated flows) from concept to completion
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders at various levels and in different locales to drive alignment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements

- Experience with CRM tools and systems that can be leveraged to drive customer engagement - including but not limited to Adobe, Salesforce, Unica, Marketo, Exact Target, Braze, etc.  

* Experience building, executing and scaling digital programmatic campaigns from concept to completion

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite, you will help shape and deliver supply chain, Mobile, and Warehouse Management solutions from discovery through release. You will work closely with engineering, design, quality assurance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve customer problems and deliver products on schedule and within budget.

You will define product strategy, requirements, and priorities using customer feedback, business needs, and product insights. A key part of the role is identifying where GenAI and intelligent automation can simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience. You will translate these opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, considering accuracy, data privacy, and user control.

Your responsibilities will include aligning teams on product decisions, reviewing designs and documentation, managing dependencies, and supporting successful releases. You will also use AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, documentation, and test planning, while applying sound judgment to their outputs.

This role requires independent judgment, strong communication, and the ability to manage complex priorities. You may lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, is required.

  

Responsbilities:

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control  

Qualifications/Skills:

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus  

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agents
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Phenom and the Agents team**
Phenom builds the AI talent platform that large enterprises use to hire, onboard and grow their people. The Agents team builds the AI agents that do hiring work end to end: the Sourcing Agent, the Intake Agent, outreach and candidate-fraud detection, along with the platform products that power them.
  
  
Our bet is goal-driven hiring. A hiring manager states an outcome, such as "20 qualified ICU nurses in Dallas this quarter", and agents work backwards through intake, sourcing and outreach to deliver it. These agents run inside Phenom and inside the tools recruiters and managers already use, connected through open standards like MCP and agent-to-agent protocols.
  
  
The work is high-stakes: agents act on candidate data and influence employment decisions for some of the largest employers in healthcare, retail and financial services.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will own a portfolio of products end to end: what they do, how well they do it, and whether customers get the hiring outcomes they paid for. The role is one part platform product manager and one part forward-deployed builder. You will define how our agents are designed, evaluated and governed, and you will also sit with enterprise customers to map their hiring workflows, demo working agents, and see deployments through to steady state.
  
  
You may also own the platform products these agents depend on, such as the hiring ontology, sourcing and data collection, document intelligence, and the hiring-data pipelines that feed reinforcement learning. A great agent is only as good as the data, structure and feedback loops beneath it.
  
  
We want someone who builds, not someone who only manages a roadmap. You prototype with coding agents before writing a spec, you write your own evals, and you can explain exactly why an agent failed on a real customer's data.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India, working closely with customers worldwide, sales and leadership
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Own an agent**
Own the vision, roadmap and outcomes for an agent (for example, sourcing, intake or fraud), from problem definition through launch, adoption and iteration.
  
  
Define each agent's job in outcome terms: what goal it accepts, what it is allowed to do on its own, and when it hands back to a recruiter or hiring manager.
  
  
Own the metrics that prove agents work, such as goal-fulfilment rate, qualified candidates delivered, time to first qualified slate and recruiter acceptance, and report them in weekly business reviews.
  
  
**Own the platform products that power agents**
Own one or more shared platform products that agents build on, for example:
  
  
**Hiring ontology:**
the structured model of skills, roles, credentials and requirements that agents reason over.
  
  
**Sourcing and data collection:**
how candidate and job data is acquired, enriched, deduplicated and kept fresh, with consent and provenance tracked.
  
  
**Document intelligence:**
parsing and understanding resumes, job descriptions, credentials and onboarding documents.
  
  
**Hiring-data RL pipelines:**
turning recruiter decisions, candidate responses and hiring outcomes into governed training and reinforcement-learning signals that make agents better over time.
  
  
Treat each platform product as a product: define its internal and external customers, roadmap, quality metrics and service levels.
  
  
Decide what belongs in the shared platform and what belongs inside a single agent, so new agents reuse capabilities instead of rebuilding them.
  
  
**Set the quality bar with evals**
Build and maintain evaluation sets drawn from real customer workflows, and decide what "good enough to ship" means for each agent.
  
  
Run regression, LLM-as-judge and human-review loops with engineering and data science, and turn failures into prioritised fixes.
  
  
Balance accuracy, latency and cost as models and prompts change.
  
  
**Work forward-deployed with strategic customers**
Lead discovery with enterprise talent-acquisition teams: map their hiring workflows, systems and constraints, and find where agents create the most value.
  
  
Build and present working agent demos that win over sceptical buyers, partnering with sales and solutions engineering on the technical win.
  
  
See deployments through hypercare to steady state, and handle escalations directly.
  
  
Turn what you learn in each deployment into reusable configurations, playbooks and platform features, so the tenth customer is faster than the first.
  
  
**Must-have Requirements**
**4+ years in product management**
, and 8+ years combining PM with adjacent product-building roles (forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, product consulting, founder, customer success, sales, etc.). At least 1 of those years spent shipping LLM-powered products used in production.
  
  
**Shipped agents, not just features.**
You have taken at least one AI agent or multi-step LLM workflow to real enterprise users, and can explain what broke in production and how you fixed it.
  
  
**Evals fluency.**
You have designed evaluation sets, defined pass/fail criteria, and used evals to decide whether to ship.
  
  
**Real technical depth.**
You understand tool calling, retrieval, orchestration, context management and the cost/latency trade-offs between models. You read API docs, and engineers trust your judgment in design reviews.
  
  
**Hands-on builder.**
You use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) regularly and prototype to test ideas before writing a PRD.
  
  
**Enterprise customer skills.**
You have led discovery, mapped complex workflows and run demos with demanding B2B buyers, and you are comfortable owning escalations.
  
  
**Outcome metrics.**
You define success as a business outcome, instrument it, and use the data to prioritise.

jobs.title: Product Manager (GenAI & Enterprise Software)
jobs.description:
Anyone can build a GenAI demo in a weekend. Making it work for real users, inside enterprise constraints, on a real deadline and budget, is where products are won. As our Product Manager for GenAI and Enterprise Software, that’s your job.
  
  
At Techdome, we build AI-first products for enterprise clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists are excellent. We need a PM who turns that talent into shipped products: someone who catches the unclear requirement, the dropped handoff, and the unspoken risk before they become delays.
  
  
**The Role in One Line**
You own each product from the first client conversation to launch and beyond: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the client relationship.
  
  
**What You’ll Work On**
Your portfolio will blend two worlds. On the GenAI side: LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous AI agents, and end-to-end workflow automation. On the enterprise side: scalable software platforms with integrations, security, and compliance requirements to match. Every product has to launch on time, stay within budget, and move the metrics our clients care about.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Shape the product: Turn client vision into clear scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are ambitious but grounded in technical reality.
* Keep teams in sync: Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are clean and nothing is left to assumption.
* Take GenAI from demo to production: Work with ML engineers to make prototypes reliable, scalable, and safe, with attention to accuracy, latency, evaluation, and cost per query.
* Bridge GenAI and enterprise needs: Fit AI features into client systems through APIs and integrations, while meeting enterprise expectations for security, data privacy, and uptime.
* Become fluent in the client’s world: Learn their industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and convert them into requirements the team can build without guesswork.
* Lead people and partners: Plan team capacity, manage third-party vendors (including LLM and cloud providers), and hold everyone to clear commitments.
* Raise risks early: Run structured change control and flag delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks (privacy, bias, hallucinations, prompt injection, runaway costs) while they’re still cheap to fix.
* Report honestly: Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
* Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: You learn our delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
* By 60 days: You independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.
* By 90 days: You’ve delivered a key milestone, improved how we run projects, and earned the trust of your team and clients.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having shipped at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a clear grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana
* Technical grounding in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect
* Strong judgment in managing risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost-optimization practices
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification
* Deep expertise in a specific industry, especially FinTech or Healthcare
* Exposure to multiple domains, and the curiosity to learn a new one fast

**Why Techdome?**

* Hard problems worth solving: Technically demanding, GenAI-driven projects across industries.
* People who raise your game: Work daily with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* A real seat at the table: Help shape how projects are planned, run, and delivered, rather than following a playbook someone else wrote.
* Growth at the edge of GenAI: Build deep expertise in one of tech’s fastest-moving fields.

**This is not a meetings-only Scrum Master role.**
We want someone who owns the quality of what goes into a sprint, not just the sprint's cadence.

Leap Metrics is hiring a Technical Product Owner / Scrum Master in Hyderabad to drive delivery of Sevida, our healthcare analytics and care management platform. You will run Scrum for a full-stack engineering team and turn business and clinical requirements into JIRA epics and stories that engineers can build from.

If a vague ticket bothers you, if you instinctively add detail, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and data fields before a story reaches sprint planning, and if you can hold your own in a technical discussion with developers, we would like to talk to you.

Do you:

* enjoy working closely with engineers on how things get built, not just when?
* want to be part of a fast-moving, growing healthcare technology team?
* want your work to directly improve care for tens of thousands of patients?

**Who we are**

Leap Metrics was founded to improve health outcomes, lower the cost of care, and improve regulatory compliance. Our platform, Sevida, stands for "in the service of human lives," and our team uses technology to serve populations with chronic healthcare needs.

We are experienced technologists, developers, designers, client advocates and entrepreneurs. Leap Metrics is headquartered in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex, with an engineering team in Hyderabad. Learn more at leapmetrics.io.

**Why work with us**

* **Meaningful mission:**
  we help providers focus on care.
* **Real ownership:**
  what you write in JIRA becomes what ships to patients and care teams.
* **Modern stack:**
  React, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, cloud delivery and CI/CD.
* **Culture:**

**What you will do**

**Product ownership and backlog quality (about half the role)**

* Turn customer, clinical, and business requirements into well-formed JIRA epics and user stories.
* Enrich every story before it reaches sprint planning: clear acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases, data fields, UI notes or wireframes, API and integration details, and test scenarios.

* Own backlog grooming and refinement with the product manager; keep the top of the backlog "ready" at least one sprint ahead.

**Scrum and delivery**

7. **Security & Compliance:** Establish secure development practices, data protection mechanisms, and compliance with industry standards.
8. **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with product managers, designers, and AI researchers to deliver impactful features rapidly and iteratively.

**Preferred candidate profile:**

1. **Experience:** 10+ years in software engineering, with at least 5 years in senior technology leadership roles.

3. **AI/ML Expertise:** Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Skilled in fine-tuning models (LoRA, PEFT) and applying evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE).

7. **Cloud & DevOps:** Experienced with AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and serverless deployments.
8. **Security Knowledge:** Strong grasp of encryption, application security, and secure SDLC principles.
9. **Leadership & Collaboration:** Effective communicator with a track record of mentoring and leading diverse technology teams in fast-paced environments.
10. **Innovation Mindset:** Passionate about emerging technologies, problem-solving, and building AI-first travel experiences.

jobs.title: Loadshare Networks - AD/D - Program Management
jobs.description:
**About Loadshare:**

LoadShare is one of Indias most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, weve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns. What sets us apart:

* Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 40,000+ rider network.
* Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800 Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
* Dual-engine model: We not only operate Indias most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
* Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility), and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
* Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country.

  

We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

* Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
* Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
* Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco
* Overall 500+ employees on roll

  
  

**Role Overview**

Loadshare Networks is a leading 3PL partner for one of our largest quick-commerce clients, playing a critical role in building and scaling their quick commerce and last-mile delivery ecosystem across India. With SaaS-led capabilities and on-ground operations spanning 150+ stores pan-India, Loadshare operates at the intersection of technology, operations, and scale.

As Associate Director – Program Management (Central Operations), you will own the rate card setup and payouts process end to end — the systems, controls and processes that determine how Delivery Executives (DEs) are paid. Rate card structures are configured, validated and deployed across a large multi-city store network, and the resulting earnings are computed, verified and released on a weekly cycle. Accuracy, turnaround and reliability/system robustness are the measures of success in this role.

The work is equal parts process design, client management and working with product. A team handles day-to-day execution and query resolution; your mandate is to make the process scalable and to solve issues at the root.

You will partner closely with Operations, Product, Tech, Finance and client stakeholders, and lead a team of analysts and associates alongside a dedicated product manager to translate strategy into execution and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.  Rate Card Configuration & Deployment**

* Own the end-to-end process for rate card setup across a large, multi-city store network — intake of requirements, validations, configuration, testing and deployment.
* Build and strengthen the controls that keep configuration accurate at scale: structured intake, review mechanisms, pre-deployment checks and clear audit trails.
* Design validation logics and process/ product mechanisms to solve root causes and prepare for requirements at future scale.
* Standardise the pay components and surge constructs already supported on the platform, benchmark against industry practice, and innovate with the pricing team.
* Manage smooth deployment during peaks through staged rollouts, release planning and clear go/no-go calls.
* Ensure configuration accuracy and turnaround time together, rather than one at the expense of the other.

  

**2.  Payouts — Accuracy & Reliability**

* Own the weekly payout cycle end to end: validation, release, and resolution of earnings-related queries from DEs.
* Increase the degree of automation in payout processing, and bring exceptions onto structured, approval-based workflows.
* Put prevention and detection controls in place and investigate defects to root cause, assess the full extent of impact, and determine the right fix — process, product or people.
* Design frameworks and execute to reduce payout-related queries at source.

**3.  Client Management**

* Own the day-to-day working relationship with the internal and external teams on rate cards, payouts and reconciliation.
* Set and hold realistic SLAs on configuration requests.
* Communicate proactively on issues, with clear resolution timelines, and resolve reconciliation queries with data.
* Run the operating cadence and reviews that keep performance visible to both sides, and consistently meet or exceed agreed service standards.

  

**4.  Product, Process & Team Enablement**

* Work with Product and Tech on internal tooling and on the DE app experience — how rate cards, surges and conditions are displayed, and how earnings are explained.
* Write and maintain team SOPs so the process is consistent and reliable.

  

**5.  Strategic & Ad-hoc Initiatives**

* Take ownership of high-priority, ambiguous problem statements as they emerge.
* Support leadership with structured analysis, dashboards and actionable recommendations.

**Skills & Competencies**

**Hard Skills**

* Strong analytical orientation, with the comfort to work directly with data to spot patterns, run checks and root-cause defects. Comfort with AI and with SQL are an advantage.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets (analysis, reconciliation, scenario modelling).
* Working knowledge of process controls — maker-checker, validation, audit trails —…

Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. **Digital Factory Global Application Analyst**
to serve as the key link between business stakeholders, solution architects, and project teams. This role is essential for translating business requirements into functional designs and ensuring successful implementation of digital initiatives. The role will also be a cornerstone in M&A-related activities, supporting the functional transition to a newly independent digital organization by helping define and deploy new systems, processes, and capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to define and document functional requirements for digital solutions that enable business continuity and transformation post-acquisition.
* Lead functional planning for M&A carve-out activities, including requirement gathering for new systems, gap analyses, and support for clean-room or transitional environments.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, and process maps.
* Collaborate with architects and technical teams to align solutions with functional expectations.
* Support workshops, design sessions, and future-state business process mapping.
* Lead user acceptance testing, training coordination, and go-live planning.
* Promote standardization and best practices across the enterprise.
* Monitor project delivery to ensure business value realization and feedback loops.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (Lean/Six Sigma a plus).
* 7+ years of experience in manufacturing or supply chain, with digital project involvement.
* Experience with functional roles in MES, ERP, APS, WMS, or related platforms.
* M&A or carve-out experience preferred, especially in functional stream design and execution.
* Fluent in English (Spanish or other languages a plus).

**Skills And Competencies**
**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes.
* Experience with requirement documentation, functional specs, and UAT.
* Familiarity with major platforms (e.g., SAP, Kinaxis, Rockwell, Siemens).
* Exposure to M&A transition environments, clean-room operations, or digital separations.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong facilitation and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate uncertainty and evolving business environments.
* Empathy for end users with a focus on value and usability.
* Highly collaborative and proactive in engaging stakeholders.

**Why Join Kidde Global Solutions?**

* Be at the forefront of driving digital transformation in a global organization with a legacy of innovation and excellence.
* Work on impactful projects that revolutionize factories and supply chains worldwide.
* Collaborate with industry leaders, leveraging state-of-the-art technologies to shape the future of manufacturing and operations.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic and inclusive workplace.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

jobs.title: Mulesoft Developer
jobs.description:
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

**Level: Integration Engineer III**

Join Deloitte’s AI & Engineering practice as an Integration Engineer III - MuleSoft and help design, build, and deploy enterprise-scale integration solutions that support business transformation. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to translate functional requirements into scalable APIs and integration services using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. You will contribute across the delivery lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, quality, and delivery execution.

**Work you'll do**

As an Integration Engineer III - MuleSoft on the AI & Engineering team, you will be responsible for:

* Collaborating with business analysts, functional teams, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and assess integration impacts across enterprise systems
* Designing and developing MuleSoft-based integration solutions aligned to architecture standards, technical design requirements, and quality expectations
* Building, testing, and deploying APIs and integration services using Anypoint Platform, DataWeave, REST, SOAP, and RAML
* Leading technical reviews, resolving design ambiguities, and providing guidance to team members throughout the development lifecycle
* Supporting agile delivery activities, including sprint ceremonies, status reporting, deliverable tracking, and automation of routine development or operational tasks

**The team**

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad

**Shift Timings:** 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 6-10 years of experience in MuleSoft Anypoint Platform API development and management
* Experience developing integrations using Anypoint Platform, DataWeave, and enterprise integration patterns
* Experience working with REST, SOAP, RAML, and Anypoint connectors and components
* Experience implementing API security, including OAuth and JSON Web Token (JWT), as well as API lifecycle management and API governance
* Experience with messaging technologies such as AMQ, ActiveMQ, Apache Kafka, or Java Message Service (JMS), and integrations with SAP, Salesforce, Workday, or Oracle
* Experience with exception handling, logging frameworks, MUnit, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
* Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer certification and a Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree

Preferred:

* Experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for integration programs
* Experience with monitoring tools used to track system health and issue resolution
* Experience with MuleSoft Composer for low-code integration development
* Experience developing JMeter scripts for load and performance testing
* Experience generating and managing TLS certificates and Java KeyStores for secure integrations
* Experience implementing event-driven integration patterns and secrets management tools

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Advertising Core Infra
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to build highly available, scalable and distributed engineering systems for one of the largest data lakes in Amazon? Does Petabyte scale excite you?  
  
Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team.  
  
We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5 growth in volume and demand. If you thrive on greenfield experimentation and shipping things that matter to the business, keep reading.  
  
As a Sr SDE on this team, you will own the core platform services that power Amazon Ads data infrastructure, consolidating legacy systems into clean, API-first services that cut job creation time from weeks to less than a day. You will build MCP-enabled AI interfaces that let AI agents create and run data pipelines on Spektr at 99%+ success rate, directly shaping how GenAI discovers and consumes data across Amazon Ads. You will design and operate high-scale Java services on AWS-native infrastructure (Spark, EMR Serverless, Kinesis, Step Functions), processing petabytes of data daily at 99.9% availability. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with key decision makers such as Product & Program Managers to understand customer requirements and brainstorm on solutions
* Design, code and deploy components and micro-services for the core job management pipeline
* Ensure testability, maintanability and low operational footprint for your code
* Participate in operational responsibilities with your team
* Innovate on AWS technology to improve latency, reduce cost and operations

  
A day in the life  

* Focus on core engineering opportunities to guarantee system availability that matches our data growth
* Work with a skilled team of engineers, managers and decision makers to consistently meet customer demand
* Automate monitoring of data availability, quality and usability via simplified metrics and drive innovations to improve guarantees for our customers

  
About the team  
The mission of the Ads Datalake team is to provide data that helps the advertising organization make informed analyses and decisions for our customers and to determine and deploy investments for future growth via a set of central and unified products and services.  
  
Our team focuses on simplicity, usability, speed, compliance, cost efficiency and enabling high-velocity decision making so our customers can generate high quality insights faster.  
  
We are a global team with presence across India and North America.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Mobile-First Consumer Internet)
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager with 4–8 years of experience building consumer internet products, ideally mobile-first apps where user engagement, retention, and growth are central to the business.

At FOXO, you'll work directly with the founders, designers, engineers, doctors, and business teams to identify consumer problems, shape product direction, and take ideas from discovery to launch. You'll use customer insights and data to make decisions, improve user experiences, and drive measurable product outcomes.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap. You'll help build one. We're looking for someone with strong product judgment, an analytical mindset, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Own product initiatives end to end:** Drive problem discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-launch improvements.
* **Build great mobile experiences:** Improve onboarding, navigation, user journeys, and the overall experience of using a consumer app.
* **Understand consumer behaviour:** Use customer interviews, feedback, behavioural data, and competitive research to identify opportunities.
* **Drive product direction:** Work with the founders to shape the roadmap and prioritize problems based on customer needs and business impact.
* **Partner with Design and Engineering:** Translate problems into clear user flows, product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* **Use data to drive decisions:** Analyse funnels, cohorts, activation, engagement, and retention to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Test ideas, evaluate outcomes, and continuously improve the product based on evidence.
* **Drive execution:** Make trade-offs, resolve bottlenecks, coordinate releases, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work with doctors and business teams to translate domain expertise into useful consumer experiences.
* **Explore AI opportunities:** Identify where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience or solve a real consumer problem.

**What We're Looking For:**

Must Have

* 4–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably in B2C or consumer internet.
* Experience at a consumer internet company building products used directly by consumers, where engagement, retention, or growth mattered.
* Strong understanding of mobile app fundamentals, including onboarding, user journeys, navigation, funnels, and repeat usage.
* Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch and subsequent iteration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use product data and customer insights to make decisions.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong product sense and attention to detail, with an understanding of the trade-offs between user experience, business outcomes, and engineering effort.
* Ability to work directly with founders, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive projects independently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A bachelor's degree from a Tier-I college or other leading undergraduate institution.

Good to Have

* Experience improving activation, conversion, engagement, retention, or other core consumer product metrics.
* Experience building mobile apps in health, wellness, lifestyle, fintech, commerce, or other consumer-focused categories.
* Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, PostHog, or similar product analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, and AI-powered productivity tools.
* Experience with AI/LLM-powered products. Prior AI experience is not a requirement.

**Location & Work Model:**

* **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
* **Work Model:** Full-time, on-site at FOXO's Bengaluru office.
* **Relocation:** Candidates currently based outside Bengaluru must be willing to relocate.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Identifying high-impact consumer problems and turning them into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Shipping quality mobile experiences with minimal supervision.
* Improving activation, engagement, retention, and other meaningful product metrics.
* Making product decisions grounded in customer behaviour, data, and sound judgment.
* Taking ownership of outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Current location (City)
* Years of experience in Product Management
* Have you worked at a consumer internet or B2C product company?
* What is your current notice period?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?

Work Location: In person

**Turn ideas into content. Turn content into conversations. Turn conversations into business growth.**

* Shopify & E-commerce Development

jobs.description:
**Business Area:**

**Seniority Level:**

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Sr. Product Manager (Backend)
jobs.description:
**About Sugar.fit**

At Sugar.fit, we are on a mission to reverse chronic metabolic diseases—starting with Type 2 diabetes and pre-diabetes—through a data-driven, compassionate, and deeply personalized approach. Combining Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) technology, precision nutrition, and expert medical coaching, we empower thousands of users across India to take control of their metabolic health and achieve sustainable outcomes.

**About the Role**

While our user-facing app delivers the daily experience, our backend systems are the true engine behind clinical reversal. We are looking for a
**Backend-Focused Product Manager / Senior Product Manager**
to own the core platform, data pipelines, and system architecture that power Sugar.fit’s consumer ecosystem.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of high-scale B2C operations, real-time IoT data ingestion, and internal care-delivery tools. You won’t just build APIs—you will architect the foundational platforms that connect continuous glucose monitors, diagnostic partners, health coaches, doctors, and end-users into one seamless, responsive ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Core Platform & System Architecture

* **Own the Backend Roadmap:**
  Define and execute the product strategy for Sugar.fit’s core backend systems, microservices, and platform infrastructure to support rapid B2C user growth.

* **IoT & Real-Time Data Pipelines:**
  Manage the ingestion, processing, and normalization of high-frequency biometric data from Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs), fitness trackers, and diagnostic labs.

* **Third-Party Integrations:**
  Lead end-to-end integrations with external ecosystems, including diagnostic logistics providers, pharmacy fulfillment networks, payment gateways, and communication engines (WhatsApp, push notifications, SMS).

2. Care-Delivery & Operational Tooling

* **Internal CRM & Clinical Engines:**
  Build and optimize the backend workflows, scheduling algorithms, and rule engines that power our doctors and health coaches, ensuring timely, personalized interventions for users.

* **Personalization & Recommendation Systems:**
  Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to build the backend infrastructure for automated health insights, metabolic scoring, and trigger-based user nudges.

3. Scale, Reliability & Security

* **Performance at B2C Scale:**
  Partner closely with Engineering Architects to define SLAs around system uptime, API latency, data consistency, and fault tolerance.

* **Health Data Governance:**
  Ensure all backend data storage, access controls, and data-sharing architectures strictly adhere to healthcare compliance, user privacy, and security standards.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **4–7 years of Product Management experience**
  in high-scale
  **B2C consumer internet**
  companies (e.g., Health-Tech, FinTech, E-Commerce, Hyperlocal Delivery, or EdTech).
  *Candidates with 6+ years and demonstrated ownership of large-scale platform charters will be considered for the Senior PM role.*

* **Strong Technical & Backend Depth:**
  Proven track record of owning non-UI/platform products—such as API ecosystems, payment/checkout engines, order management systems, logistics/supply chain backends, notification engines, or data platforms.

* **Architectural Fluency:**
  Comfortable discussing system design, database schemas, asynchronous workflows, webhook reliability, and API contracts with senior engineers without needing to write production code yourself.

* **Systems Thinking:**
  Ability to break down complex, multi-actor operational workflows (User $\leftrightarrow$ Device $\leftrightarrow$ Lab $\leftrightarrow$ Coach $\leftrightarrow$ Doctor) into scalable, modular backend services.

* **Data-First Mindset:**
  Strong proficiency in SQL and product analytics tools to independently query datasets, diagnose system bottlenecks, and measure the business impact of platform improvements.

* **B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or a related technical field**
  (or equivalent practical engineering experience prior to transitioning into Product Management) is strongly preferred.

**Success Metrics (What You Will Own)**

* **System Reliability & Latency:**
  API response times, CGM data sync success rates, and reduction in integration failure rates.

* **Operational Efficiency:**
  Coach/Doctor productivity metrics, automated workflow resolution rates, and reduction in manual ops interventions.

* **Fulfillment & Care SLAs:**
  Turnaround time (TAT) for diagnostic bookings, device shipments, and real-time clinical escalations.

**Why Join Sugar.fit?**

* **High-Impact Mission:**
  Your work directly translates to people lowering their blood sugar, reducing medication dependency, and reclaiming their health.

* **Complex Technical Challenges:**
  Solve unique problems combining hardware (CGM sensors), real-time biometric data streams, AI-driven health insights, and human-in-the-loop clinical care.

* **Ownership & Autonomy:**
  High-trust environment where you own the problem space end-to-end alongside top-tier engineers, clinicians, and designers.

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. We are seeking a product manager to help deliver a new AI-based platform powering a new family of Instream Video Intelligence (ISVI) products. You will work with a team of product experts in their field, and report to Gracenote’s SVP of Product.
  
  
Gracenote AI is an exciting new growth vector for Gracenote. This role will be hugely impactful in shaping commercial strategy, product strategy, and pricing to mature our VLM-based products in a rapidly-evolving technological landscape, and will play a significant role in how Gracenote helps the world's largest CTV apps and platforms power search and discovery.
  
  
The ideal candidate excels at product coordination and delivery, and will contribute directly to the success of these emergent products. This role requires a practitioner with a solutions-oriented mindset who understands the potential of VLM technology in the entertainment metadata industry and can execute to fruition.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the Gracenote ISVI platform roadmap. Define and deliver LLM and Grounding products and platforms that anticipate the needs of the entertainment industry, with a specific focus on Video and Sports in Connected Television (CTV).
* Work with a team of talented product managers, sharing knowledge, and aligning Gracenote’s expertise in entertainment metadata with the rapidly evolving capabilities of vision language models, coordinating deliverables and timing with your Product counterparts in the US.
* Collaborate with internal cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to evangelize and articulate Gracenote’s AI vision and strategy.
* Coordinate with Engineering colleagues and counterparts to ensure development resources are aligned with product priorities; collaborate with engineering, data science, UX, commercial, and external partners to deliver exceptional products.
* Engage with customers to understand their problems and ensure we are building products with strong commercial potential.

**Qualifications**
**5+ years**
experience leading technology product teams.
  
  
Demonstrated and detailed knowledge of the capability, potential, and pitfalls of language models and probabilistic technologies.
  
  
Applied experience in creating products that leverage language models to address domain-specific use cases, ideally employing large-scale, authoritative datasets.
  
  
Strong executive disposition and communication skills, with the ability to build trust in evolving data and technology environments.
  
  
Preferred: Experience in understanding and overcoming the business and technical challenges of the CTV/entertainment metadata space.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

* Lead efforts to implement policies, procedures and system enhancements to fill current and future Data Governance Gaps
* Provide all the support to Data Governance/Data Stewards including Partner / stakeholder management, expectations settings with partners, prioritization of work to team members, and act as Data and functional SME.
* Develop and maintain project management trackers and provide regular updates to managers, senior leadership team and stakeholders.
* Ensuring required controls, checks, governance, process documentation is always up-to date and maintained regularly
  

  

**Expertise Required:**

**Analytical Skills**

* Data analysis and visualization
* Proficient in formulating analytical methodology, identifying trends and patterns with data
* Generate actionable Business Insights

**Tools and Platforms**

* Data Lineage Tools , Metadata Management Tools (.i.e. Collibra or Solidatus etc..)
* Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word
* Understanding of Enterprise Data Warehouse like Bigdata, Teradata
* Exposure to SAS, Python, SQL/data retrieving tools

**Domain Skills**

Good understanding of

* Data definitions and data discovery
* Data quality framework
* Data Governance including identification of critical data elements, measuring and monitoring of CDE’s
* Process improvement experience pertains to compliance and data quality initiatives
* Hands on experience on KPI’s design, issue resolution and remediation activities
* Identification of control gaps and providing recommendations as per data strategy
* Measuring effectiveness of different DQ roll out programs

jobs.title: AVP-Product Analyst
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 7+ years of experience in product analysis, digital assets, financial technology, blockchain infrastructure, tokenization or capital markets with demonstrated proficiency architecting blockchain solutions and DeFi applications and comprehensive knowledge of blockchain technology stack
* Strong understanding of digital asset market structure, tokenization, stablecoins, distributed ledger technologies and digital market infrastructure along with experience in deriving or assessing digital asset risks for blockchain platforms, smart contracts, blockchain oracles and wallet infrastructure
* Product management experience and knowledge of smart contract development, with Solidity, DAML, Rust or Canton Network architecture certifications preferred
* Working exposure to structured and unstructured data sources, including on-chain and off-chain data
* Experience supporting pilots, integrations or multi-stakeholder initiatives in a build-test-scale environment
* Ability to translate emerging market developments and business objectives into strategic initiatives and executable priorities
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical, analytical, commercial and risk stakeholders
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows, enhance operational efficiency and support responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience in finance, economics, business, technology, engineering, data analytics or a related field

**Responsibilities**
Advance digital asset product capabilities that deliver credit-relevant insights across evolving financial markets.
  
  

* Monitor developments across digital assets, tokenization, stablecoins and emerging market infrastructure to identify relevant product opportunities
* Support evaluation and prioritization of strategic initiatives that strengthen Moody’s Ratings’ position within evolving digital financial markets
* Translate market developments, client needs and business priorities into actionable plans, capability enhancements and roadmap inputs
* Support the definition and evolution of technology architecture, including integrations with blockchain networks, tokenization platforms, oracle frameworks, application programming interfaces and external platforms
* Partner with analytical, technology and operational stakeholders to identify capability enhancements, technical designs and implementation roadmaps
* Analyze stakeholder needs and emerging opportunities to support product strategy, capability development, planning and governance activities
* Support initiatives related to interoperability, settlement, custody and asset mobility across digital asset ecosystems
* Communicate complex market, business and technology developments to senior stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner

**About The Team**
Our Digital Economy team within Moody’s Ratings supports the firm’s strategy for innovative technologies including digital assets, tokenization, decentralized finance, stablecoins, on-chain infrastructure and data-driven innovation. The team works across analytical, technology, risk oversight, commercial and operational functions to develop scalable capabilities that help Moody’s Ratings understand, assess, ingest and deliver credit-relevant insights in digital financial markets. By joining the team, you will contribute to product-focused work at the intersection of digital assets, emerging technologies and capital markets, while supporting responsible adoption of artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve workflows and strengthen business readiness.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Oracle’s Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) in Bangalore is a strategic shared-services finance center supporting Oracle Finance. Within GFIC, the Accounts Receivables Center of Excellence manages global invoice-delivery operations and supports Oracle’s response to the evolving global e-invoicing and e-reporting landscape.

**Job Summary**

The **Global E-Invoicing Business Analyst – IC3** will support the design, implementation, and rollout of e-invoicing and e-reporting capabilities across multiple countries.

This role serves as a bridge between country-specific regulatory requirements and the teams responsible for delivering scalable global solutions, including Tax, Finance, IT, Legal/Compliance, local teams, and external e-invoicing service providers.

The Business Analyst will take end-to-end ownership of assigned country requirements—from regulatory discovery and requirements definition through data mapping, testing, go-live, and stabilization—while promoting reuse of global standards and solution components.

**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Level:** IC3

**Job Title**
Manager / Senior Manager – Business Analyst (Digital Transformation – Finance & Accounting)
  
  
**Experience**
7–12 Years
  
  
Location: Noida/Banglore
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Manager / Senior Manager – Business Analyst with strong Finance & Accounting (F&A) expertise to drive enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. This is a techno-functional and client-facing role requiring a strategic mindset, deep domain knowledge, and the ability to bridge business and technology.
  
  
The role demands a consultative professional capable of leading transformation programs, engaging with senior stakeholders, and delivering impactful solutions across finance processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Digital Transformation & Strategy
* Lead and drive digital transformation initiatives across Finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, FP&A, Treasury).
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities using RPA, AI/ML, ERP transformation, and analytics tools.
* Define and influence digital strategy, transformation roadmap, and business case development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to clients/business leadership.
* Business Analysis & Solutioning
* Lead end-to-end business analysis lifecycle – requirement gathering, documentation (BRD/FRD), and validation.
* Perform process mapping (AS-IS / TO-BE), gap analysis, and impact assessments.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs and solution frameworks.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solution alignment with business goals.
* Finance Domain Leadership
* Provide deep expertise in: - Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
* Order-to-Cash (O2C)
* Record-to-Report (R2R)
* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Drive process excellence, standardization, and governance frameworks.
* Support ERP implementations and enhancements (SAP / Oracle / MS Dynamics / Others).
* Client & Stakeholder Management
* Serve as a primary client interface, managing stakeholder expectations.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and executive presentations.
* Build strong relationships and act as a trusted transformation partner.
* Influence of decision-making at senior leadership levels.
* Techno-Functional Delivery
* Work closely with IT teams to support solution design, development, UAT, and deployment.
* Ensure successful implementation of automation and digital tools (RPA, workflow tools, AI solutions).
* Drive Agile delivery where applicable and ensure on-time project execution.
* Data, Reporting & Value Realization
* Define KPIs, dashboards, and reporting metrics for finance transformation.
* Enable data-driven insights using Power BI, Tableau, etc.
* Track and communicate business value, ROI, and performance improvement metrics.

Mandatory Skills & Competencies
  
  
Finance & Accounting Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end F&A processes
* Solid understanding of accounting standards, financial reporting, and compliance

Business Analysis
  
  

* Expertise in requirement elicitation, process modeling, documentation
* Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Visio, BPMN, UML

Digital & Technology
  
  

* Experience in digital transformation, automation (RPA), ERP transformation
* Understanding of system architecture, integrations, APIs
* Exposure to data analytics & visualization tools

Client-Facing & Consulting
  
  

* Strong experience in client engagement and stakeholder management
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Strategic thinking with problem-solving and decision-making capability

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA (Finance) / CMA / CPA
* Certifications: CBAP, PMI-PBA, Agile/Scrum
* Experience in consulting / shared services / transformation programs

Leadership Expectations (Manager / Senior Manager Level)
  
  

* Ability to lead teams and mentor junior analysts
* Drive program-level delivery and governance
* Strong ownership of deliverables and client satisfaction
* Manage multiple projects and priorities effectively
